senses.gloss:
€1P. 
__1 To transgress, offend against, violate. 
__2 To be faithless to. 
__3 To commit adultery with; विपरीतास्तदा नार्यो वञ्चयित्वार्हतः पतीन् । व्युच्चरन्त्यपि दुःशीला दासैः पशुभिरेव च ॥ [[Mb. 3. 188. 63.]] 
__4 To deviate from the right path.
Transgression, deviation.
f., व्युच्छेदः Cutting off, extermination, complete destruction.

व्युतः,
 
-तिः See व्यूतः.
See उत्क्रम्.

__1 Transgression, going astray; श्लाघा साऽस्मद्वपुषि विनयव्युत्क्रमेऽप्येष रागः [[Ve. 2. 11.]] 
__2 Inverted order, contrariety. 
__3 Confusion, disorder.
Going apart, separation; [[P. VIII. 1. 15.]]

p. p. 
__1 Transgressed, overstepped. 
__2 Departed, left, gone forth. 
__3 Neglected. 
-ता A kind of riddle. 
-Comp. 
-जीवित a. dead.

€1Ā. 
__1 To get up, rise. 
__2 To increase in strength or power, grow strong. 
__3 To oppose, resist, say something in opposition; इति व्युत्तिष्ठमानायां तस्यामूचे नलः प्रियाम् [[N. 20. 124.]] -Caus. 
__1 To excite, instigate, rouse. 
__2 To disagree about. 
__3 To win over. 
__4 To remove.

व्युत्थानम्,
व्युत्थितिः f. 
__1 Great activity. 
__2 Rising up against, opposition, obstruction. 
__3 Independent action, following one's own bent of mind; व्युत्थानं च विकाङ्क्षाद्भिः कथाभिः प्रतिलोभ्यते [[Mb. 12. 111. 43.]] 
__4 The completion of religious abstraction or abstract meditation (in Yoga phil.). 
__5 A kind of dance. 
__6 Causing (an elephant) to rise; यावच्चक्रे नाञ्जनं बोधनाय व्युत्थानज्ञो हस्तिचारी मदस्य [[Śi. 18. 26.]] 
__7 Contradicting.

p. p. 
__1 Greatly divergent in opinion. 
__2 Swerving from duty (उच्छास्त्रवर्तिन्); व्युत्थितोत्पत्तिविज्ञानमाकाशे च गतिः शुभा [[Mb. 6. 15. 9.]]

€4Ā. 
__1 To be produced from, originate in. 
__2 To be derived from (a root &c.); नाम रूढमपि च व्युदपादि [[Śi. 10. 23.]] 
__3 To become proficient in or conversant with. -Caus. 
__1 To produce, cause. 
__2 To derive, trace to a root (as a word); ब्रह्मशब्दस्य व्युत्पाद्यमानस्य [[Ś. B.]]

f. 
__1 Origin, production. 
__2 Derivation, etymology. 
__3 Perfect proficiency, conversancy. 
__4 Scholarship, learning; व्युत्पत्तिरावर्जितकोविदापि न रञ्जनाय [Page1521-2] क्रमते जडानाम् [[Vikr. 1. 16]]; 18. 108. 
__5 Difference of tone or sound.

p. p. 
__1 Produced, begotten. 
__2 Formed by derivation. 
__3 Derived, traced to its etymology, as a word (opp. अव्युत्पन्न or ‘primitive’). 
__4 Completed, perfected; [[Mv. 4. 57.]] 
__5 Thoroughly proficient in, learned, erudite.

__1 Derivation from. 
__2 Teaching, instruction.
p. p. Wetted, drenched.
a. Interwoven, sewn, interlaced.

व्युद,
व्युदक a. Waterless; उपारतं वातवर्षं व्युदप्रायाश्च निम्नगाः [[Bhāg. 10. 25. 26.]]

€4P. 
__1 To throw or scatter about. 
__2 To throw off, cast away. 
__3 To set or lay aside. 
__4 To give up, abandon.
p. p. Thrown aside, rejected, cast off.

__1 Throwing aside, rejection; अथैकान्तव्युदासेन शरीरे पाञ्चभौतिके [[Mb. 12. 19. 18.]] 
__2 Exclusion (in gram.). 
__3 Prohibition. 
__4 Disregard, indifference. 
__5 Killing, destruction; [[Śi. 15. 37.]]
a. Disputed, discussed, debated.
Pretext, pretence.
Cessation, stop, close; खरस्नायुच्छेदक्षणविहितवेगव्युपरमः (v. l. व्युपशमः) [[Māl. 5. 34.]]
p. p. Rested, stopped; अन्तःप्राणावरोधव्युपरतसकलज्ञानरुद्धेन्द्रियस्य [[Mk. 1. 1.]]

__1 Non-cessation. 
__2 Inquietude. 
__3 Complete cessation (where वि shows intensity).

p. p. 
__1 Shorn, shaved. 
__2 Scattered, disordered. 
-Comp. 
-केश a. having dishevelled hair; अटत्युन्मत्तवन्नग्नो व्युप्तकेशो हसन् रुदन् [[Bhāg. 4. 2. 14.]]

= प्युष् 10 P. 
__1 To void, emit. 
__2 To reject.
p. p. See व्युष्ट; व्युषितायां रजन्यां तु कर्णो राजानमभ्यगात् [[Mb. 3. 238. 17.]]

p. p. 
__1 Burnt. 
__2 Dawned, become day-light. 
__3 Become bright or clear; ततो रजन्यां व्युष्टायां प्रभातेऽभ्युदिते रवौ [[Mb. 1. 21. 1.]] 
__4 Dwelt; सा व्युष्टा रजनीं तत्र पितुर्वेश्मनि भाविनी [[Mb. 3. 69. 28.]] 
__5 Passed. 
-ष्टम् 
__1 Day-break, dawn; व्युष्टं प्रयाणम् [[Śi. 12. 4.]] 
__2 Day. 
__3 Fruit, result. 
__4 The new year's day on श्रावण; [[Kau. A. 2. 5.]]

f. 
__1 Dawn. 
__2 Prosperity; व्युष्टिरेषा परा स्त्रीणाम् [[Mb. 1. 158. 22]]; 13. 61. 14. 
__3 Grace, beauty; तदेतत् कीर्तिश्च व्युष्टिश्चेत्युपासीत कीर्तिमान् व्युष्टिमान् भवति य एवं वेद [[Ch. Up. 3. 14. 4.]] 
__4 Praise. 
__5 Fruit, consequence; यत्तत्तस्य त्वया व्युष्टिः प्राप्तेयं प्लवगाधिप [[Rām. 4. 20. 11]]; [[Mb. 13. 26. 31.]]

__1 Weaving, sewing. 
__2 The wages of weaving.

€1P. 
__1 To arrange troops in battle array; सूच्या वज्रेण चैबैतान् व्यूहेन व्यूह्य योधयेत् [[Ms. 7. 191.]] 
__2 To arrange, put or place in order, dispose. 
__3 To separate, divide. 
__4 To alter, transpose, disarrange. 
__5 To resolve (vowels, syllables &c.).

p. p. 
__1 Expanded, developed, broad, wide; व्यूढोरस्को वृषस्कन्धः [[R. 1. 13.]] 
__2 Firm, compact. 
__3 Placed in order, arranged, marshalled (as an army); तेन व्यूढेन सैन्येन लोकानुद्वर्तयन्निव [[Mb. 3. 283. 15]]; दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवानीकं व्यूढं दुर्योधनस्तदा [[Bg. 1. 3.]] 
__4 Disarranged, placed out of order; दिक्षु व्यूढाङ्घ्रिपाड्गस्तृणजटिलचलत्पांशुदण्डोऽन्तरिक्षे [[Ve. 2. 19.]] 
__5 Married; व्यूढायाश्चापि पुंश्चल्या मनोऽभ्येति नवं नवम् [[Bhāg. 10. 60. 48.]] 
__6 Large, great. 
-Comp. 
-कङ्कट a. mailed, clad in armour.
f. Orderly arrangement, array.

__1 A military array; दण्डव्यूहेन तन्मार्गं यायात्तु शकटेन वा । वराहमकराभ्यां वा सूच्या वा गरुडेन वा ॥ [[Ms. 7. 187]]; cf. दण्डव्यूहः, शकट°, वराह°, सर्वतोभद्र° etc. mentioned in [[Dhanur.]] 
__2 An army, a host, squadron; व्यूहावुभौ तावितरेतरस्मात् भङ्गं जयं चापतुरव्यवस्थम् [[R. 7. 54.]] 
__3 A large quantity, an assemblage, a multitude, collection; विमिश्रा विहगाः पुंभिरात्मव्यूहाभिनन्दिताः [[Rām. 4. 1. 27]]; गुणव्यूहः [[Bhāg. 4. 29. 71.]] 
__4 A part, portion, subhead. 
__5 The body. 
__6 Structure, formation. 
__7 Reasoning, logic. 
__8 Separation, distribution. 
__9 (In phil.) A peculiar arrangement of the senses. 
-Comp. 
-पार्ष्णिः f. the rear of an army. 
-भङ्गः, -भेदः breaking an array. 
-रचना arrangement of troops. 
-विभागः a distinctive array of army; पक्षकक्षा-उरस्यानां बलाग्रतो व्यूहविभागाः [[Kau. A. 10.]]

__1 Arraying of troops, marshalling. 
__2 Structure of the members of the body. 
__3 Development (of the foetus). 
__4 Displacement.
